properties.name: canal.concurrency-count
properties.description: RabbitMQ listener concurrency count passed to @RabbitListener.

properties.name: canal.canal-queue-name
properties.description: Queue name consumed by the application.

properties.name: canal.exchange-name
properties.description: Exchange name used by the Canal producer.

properties.name: canal.routing-key
properties.description: Routing key written into the queue binding.

properties.name: canal.mq-type
properties.description: Message middleware that consumes Canal messages. Exactly one type is active.

properties.name: canal.consumer-enabled
properties.description: Whether consumer side infrastructure is assembled at all.

properties.name: canal.config-source
properties.description: Configuration source: local, nacos or blank for class path detection.

properties.name: canal.retry.max-attempts
properties.description: Maximum re-delivery attempts for retryable failures.

properties.name: canal.dead-letter.routing-key
properties.description: Routing key binding the dead letter queue to the dead letter exchange.

properties.name: canal.handler-cache-size
properties.description: Upper bound of the resolved handler cache.

properties.name: canal.handler-miss-log-level
properties.description: Log level used when no table level handler exists: off, debug, warn-once or warn.

properties.name: canal.rocketmq.topic
properties.description: RocketMQ topic consumed by the application. Required when canal.mq-type=rocketmq.

properties.name: canal.rocketmq.consumer-group
properties.description: RocketMQ consumer group. Required when canal.mq-type=rocketmq.

properties.name: canal.rocketmq.tag
properties.description: RocketMQ tag expression used as the selector.

properties.name: canal.rocketmq.dead-letter-topic
properties.description: Optional RocketMQ topic receiving non retryable payloads.
